# Profiles and Addresses Requirements Quality Checklist

**Purpose**: Review completeness, clarity, consistency and acceptance readiness of profile/privacy and address-invariant requirements before task generation and peer review.
**Created**: 2026-10-26
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the current specification, clarification decisions and planning artifacts. Standard depth; reviewer audience; focus on profile privacy/update semantics and address ownership/concurrency, including dependency boundaries. No additional preferences were supplied; context determines this scope.
**Review Ownership**: This is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only after the reviewer determines its requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means reviewed requirements quality, not completed implementation. Newly generated items remain unchecked until review; the review below records the current disposition.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are self-profile, limited-profile and address-book capabilities explicitly bounded against authentication, administration and storage exclusions? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-001]
- [x] CHK002 Are allowed private, public and address response fields exhaustively specified, including nullable-field representation? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-003, Spec ?FR-004, Spec ?FR-012]
- [x] CHK003 Are required address recipient fields and their create/update obligations documented independently of default selection? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 Are immutable profile fields and the rejection of attempts to modify them explicitly defined? [Completeness, Spec ?FR-005]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK005 Are omitted, explicit-null, blank and supplied-value meanings separately defined for every profile field group? [Clarity, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation]
- [x] CHK006 Are surrounding-whitespace removal, internal-whitespace preservation and post-normalization maximum lengths unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation]
- [x] CHK007 Are email lowercase storage, preserved username display casing and case-insensitive uniqueness clearly distinguished from other text comparisons? [Clarity, Spec ?FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is the distinction between optional profile phone constraints and the exact ten-ASCII-digit address-phone rule explicit? [Clarity, Spec ?FR-009, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation]
- [x] CHK009 Is later-successful-write ordering defined independently of request arrival time, with omitted profile fields preserving the latest state? [Clarity, Spec ?FR-015]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK010 Are authentication-only access and the absence of extra role or account-status restrictions consistent across stories, requirements and contracts? [Consistency, Spec ?FR-002, Spec ?User Story 3, Contracts ?HTTP Contract]
- [x] CHK011 Are selective profile updates and required-field address updates consistently distinguished throughout the documents? [Consistency, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation, Contracts ?Address request contracts]
- [x] CHK012 Are default creation, promotion, demotion rejection and deletion fallback rules identical across stories and transition tables? [Consistency, Spec ?FR-010, Spec ?User Story 2, Data Model ?Aggregate invariants and transitions]
- [x] CHK013 Are request limits, stored-field limits and public field descriptions consistent between specification, data model and contract? [Consistency, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation, Data Model ?User - users, Contracts ?Schemas]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK014 Can every functional requirement be traced to an observable acceptance outcome without relying on a vague claim of correct behavior? [Measurability, Spec ?Functional Requirements, Spec ?Measurable Outcomes]
- [x] CHK015 Are privacy criteria expressed as exact field allowlists and zero-disclosure outcomes rather than general statements about security? [Measurability, Spec ?FR-004, Spec ?SC-002]
- [x] CHK016 Are concurrent-edit, capacity and lock-timeout criteria explicit enough to distinguish acceptable outcomes from partial failures? [Measurability, Spec ?FR-015, Spec ?FR-016, Spec ?FR-017]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK017 Are primary profile and address journeys, empty books and no-op profile updates documented? [Coverage, Spec ?User Scenarios & Testing, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation]
- [x] CHK018 Are avatar preservation, removal, replacement and invalid-reference outcomes all defined without implying storage deletion? [Coverage, Spec ?FR-007]
- [x] CHK019 Are all default-flag input combinations covered for first create, later create and default/non-default updates? [Coverage, Spec ?Field Presence and Validation]
- [x] CHK020 Are default and non-default deletion outcomes defined for both remaining-address and final-address cases? [Coverage, Spec ?User Story 2]
- [x] CHK021 Are missing and foreign-address requirements intentionally indistinguishable for every owned-resource operation? [Coverage, Spec ?FR-008]
- [x] CHK022 Are rollback requirements specified for failures after partial default-transition work as well as profile uniqueness failures? [Recovery, Spec ?FR-011, Spec ?Edge Cases]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK024 Are unchanged normalized identities, case-only edits, another-user conflicts and concurrent duplicate claims distinguished? [Coverage, Spec ?FR-006, Spec ?Additional acceptance scenarios]

- [x] CHK027 Are lock-timeout response, rollback, safe retry wording and client-owned retry decisions defined together? [Coverage, Spec ?FR-017]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK029 Are error representation and sensitive-information exclusions consistent for validation, authentication, authorization, missing-resource and conflict cases? [Security, Spec ?Error Behavior]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK035 Are unapproved prerequisite changes and unresolved external identifier contracts visibly separated from confirmed feature decisions? [Ambiguity, Spec ?Confirmed Clarification Decisions, Plan ?Constitution Check, Contracts ?Approval and sequencing gates]

## Notes

- Review requirements writing, not software behavior or implementation completion. These questions do not establish new requirements or declare findings satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked until reviewer evaluation; record findings and supporting document sections inline.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` is the separate built-in spec-quality checklist maintained by specify/clarify; its existing markers are unchanged.
- References use section headings and FR/SC identifiers from the linked specification; Contracts, Data Model, Research and Plan references refer to adjacent feature artifacts.
